baseline.evidence: Reference SHOT-01 was user-confirmed. Current Electron render captured at /var/folders/jw/5mwwlr9d6t51k0rpdmdw9q600000gn/T/com.openai.sky.CUAService/Electron Screenshot 2026-08-14 at 3.44.05 PM.jpeg (1152x768), with one JINGZAO file-list tab.

mismatches.screenshot_evidence: SHOT-01 shows one Finder title/toolbar region, a sidebar, a list content region, and a bottom edge without a product-specific tab strip.
mismatches.current_evidence: Electron after capture has a continuous single-tab file list with Finder chrome, but its sidebar remains application-specific and its titlebar still contains separate utility actions.
mismatches.diagnosis: The single-tab layout now follows the Finder shell, while application controls and sidebar grouping still create structural differences from SHOT-01.
mismatches.reason: Visual capture now exists, but the reference has no product tab/action band and uses a Finder-native sidebar grouping.
mismatches.impact: The main hierarchy is improved but not a pixel-equivalent Finder composition.
mismatches.next_action: If pixel parity is required, merge the remaining utility actions into an overflow menu and map app-specific sources into Finder sidebar groups.

mismatches.screenshot_evidence: SHOT-01 places back/forward, view switches, sort, sharing, tags, overflow, and search in one compact Finder toolbar.
mismatches.current_evidence: Electron after capture places navigation, search, view switches, share/tag and file actions in the FilePane toolbar; theme, operations, and settings remain in the titlebar.
mismatches.diagnosis: The core Finder controls are present and styled compactly, but app utility controls remain split across a second chrome row.
mismatches.reason: The after capture verifies control density and order, but includes extra app operations absent from SHOT-01.
mismatches.impact: Toolbar semantics work while exact Finder composition remains different.
mismatches.next_action: Consolidate app-only controls behind the Finder overflow action if the product should prioritize exact screenshot parity.

mismatches.screenshot_evidence: SHOT-01 sidebar is organized as personal favorites, locations, then colored tags; JINGZAO has a neutral selected row.
mismatches.current_evidence: Electron after capture uses Locations, External Volumes, Mobile Devices, Places, Favorites, and Preview; JINGZAO uses the application active-blue treatment.
mismatches.diagnosis: The proportions, separators, and row treatment are Finder-like, but the information architecture reflects Fileman's device-management capabilities rather than SHOT-01's Finder groups.
mismatches.reason: The after capture provides evidence of the remaining group and selected-state differences.
mismatches.next_action: Add a Finder-compatible personal/tag grouping while retaining device management behind a disclosure or overflow surface.

mismatches.screenshot_evidence: SHOT-01 uses a white rounded canvas, fine separators, about 20px list rows, and restrained gray selection/chrome treatments.
mismatches.current_evidence: Electron after capture uses the light Finder token set, thin separators, 26px list rows, alternating gray list rows, and a bright blue application selection.
mismatches.diagnosis: The neutral canvas, compact controls, list columns, and zebra rows have converged; chrome height, list-row height, and selected color still differ from SHOT-01.
mismatches.reason: Measured screenshot comparison is now available and identifies residual proportion/color differences.
mismatches.impact: The visual system is Finder-inspired but cannot yet claim pixel parity.
mismatches.next_action: Use a same-size 1920px render to tune the remaining titlebar and row-height values.

mismatches.screenshot_evidence: SHOT-01 uses semantic toolbar, sidebar, folder, file, and tag icons throughout.
mismatches.current_evidence: Electron after capture shows semantic folder, document, navigation, view, and toolbar icons; FinderIcon maps supplied Lucide assets for the shared Finder controls.
mismatches.diagnosis: Semantic coverage is complete, while some app-specific source icons and color treatments intentionally differ from Finder's native glyphs.
mismatches.reason: Visual review verifies semantic coverage but reveals non-native app-specific icon styling.
mismatches.impact: Icon placement is functional; exact glyph parity is not claimed.
mismatches.next_action: Replace remaining inline app glyphs with the shared FinderIcon registry if native-style glyph consistency becomes a release requirement.

mismatches.screenshot_evidence: SHOT-01 confirms a neutral gray selected JINGZAO sidebar row and a default populated list state.
mismatches.current_evidence: Electron after capture confirms a populated list state but renders selected JINGZAO with a saturated blue row; the empty state was not part of SHOT-01.
mismatches.diagnosis: The populated state is verified; selected color differs, and empty state remains inferred.
mismatches.reason: SHOT-01 supplies only the selected sidebar and populated-list reference; it exposes a selected-color mismatch.
mismatches.impact: Selected and empty-state parity remains incomplete.
mismatches.next_action: Tune sidebar selection to neutral inactive gray and capture an empty-state Finder reference before claiming complete state parity.
